summary: 2026-11-26 to 11-27: llama.cpp v1.1.0 FORMALLY RELEASED (2026-11-26T09:16Z, version bump in b12752) and recorded - old llama_batch API deprecated in favour of llama_batch_ext/llama_process, DFlash speculative decoding split into draft-dflash/draft-dflash2/draft-dspark/draft-lilicorr with llama_dflash_variant, per-tensor automatic quantization targeting target_bpw/target_size in llama_model_quantize_params, server slot-scheduling refactor, token-aware chat parsing and named tool_choice, ggml updated to v1.1.1, new model support for Inkling 2 family, Domyn Edge 4B, Zaya1 8B, RAON-1-mini (30B-A4B MoE), Hy4 flash (220B/12B active, DSA iSWA cache) and MiniMax-M3.1 conversion (runtime support only, not new model releases). Dev builds continued to b12791 (b12785 DFlash2 for Inkling-2-Mini, b12780 BF16 src1 in MUL_MAT/MUL_MAT_ID on CPU/CUDA, b12778 CUDA fusion of top-k MoE weight norm with additive sum bias, b12722 OpenCL coopmat MoE kernels for Q4/Q5/Q6_K/MXFP4, b12732 async input copies in ggml, b12734 Metal chunked graph commit; no speed multipliers published). No new formal release in window: vLLM v0.34.0, SGLang v0.5.23, TensorRT-LLM v1.3.0, LMDeploy v0.18.0, vLLM-Omni v0.34.0 remain latest; Ollama v0.40.19-rc0 (2026-11-26) is a prerelease only and was not recorded, v0.40.18 remains latest formal. MLX v0.32.5 (2026-11-25) checked - patch-level fixes and small SDPA/qmm kernels, below the recording threshold used for this page. All LLM series (Qwen, DeepSeek, Gemma, Llama, Mistral, GLM, Kimi, MiniMax, Phi, Nemotron, GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok): no primary-confirmed important updates in window; HF org pages checked (only bulk metadata updates, robotics CogACT2 and Nemotron rerank checkpoints are outside the tracked LLM series scope). A secondary release calendar listed Qwen-Audio-3.1 on 2026-11-26 but no official Qwen HF checkpoint or primary announcement could be confirmed, so it was not recorded. Direct-apply per skill section 9 (Phase 1).
